bio: Francesco Filippo was baptized on 24 September 1719, son of Antonino Colosimo and Antonia Mendicino ([R4-S1]). He married Giulia Putero on 26 February 1740 ([R4-S2]). His mother, Antonia Mendicino, is new to the tree.
